base_predicates_are_the_corpus.why: these are the map's records verbatim. They are regenerated rather than committed, on the project's standing rule that the corpus is never committed and the command that reproduces it is

predicates.attachment: a wall record carried by a surface's frame
predicates.block: a mass between the streets, with its envelope
predicates.candidate: a reading that could go more than one way, kept
predicates.claims: an aspect says it determines one field of one record
predicates.condition: a state a topology depends on
predicates.connects: two sectors share a two-sided record
predicates.corridor: a street: road pieces of one axis and one width
predicates.edge_segment: a run of boundary records of one edge kind
predicates.frame: the projection of one surface: origin, scale, phase
predicates.island: a height island: sectors standing one rise above the ground
predicates.join: how two surfaces meet at one shared record
predicates.light_source: a source that is not the sun
predicates.link: a tx -> rx relation between records
predicates.part_of: a record belongs to a place, in one aspect's hierarchy
predicates.plan_edge: an edge of the street graph, with a width class
predicates.realises: which records a sentence is made of
predicates.sector: one Build sector record, its fields verbatim
predicates.selection: a named pass choosing among candidates, with its criterion
predicates.sentence: one mechanism, read as a sentence
predicates.shade_depth: how many shadows deep a sector's floor is
predicates.sprite: one Build sprite record, its fields verbatim
predicates.sun: the level's directional source, as a throw bearing
predicates.surface: a set of wall records one projected material would produce
predicates.surface_kind: what kind of surface a sector's floor is
predicates.unknown_join: a shared record whose pair the writer's table has no row for
predicates.wall: one Build wall record, its fields verbatim
